043package dev.visdb.seesaw.formatting;
044
045import java.text.DecimalFormat;
046import java.text.NumberFormat;
047import java.util.Locale;
048import java.util.Objects;
049
050import javax.swing.text.DefaultFormatterFactory;
051
052import static dev.visdb.seesaw.formatting.NumberField.createNumberFormat;
053
054/**
055 * Used to bind a SSFormattedTextField to a percentage column in a database.
056 */
057@SuppressWarnings("serial")
058public class SsPercentField extends NumberField {
059  /**
060   * Creates a default object of SSPercentField
061   */
062  public SsPercentField() {
063    this(createFormatterFactory(SsFormat.CUSTOM, null, null));
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Creates a default object of SSPercentField.
068   * @param precision - number of digits needed for integer part of the number
069   * @param decimals  - number of digits needed for the fraction part of the number
070   */
071  public SsPercentField(int precision, int decimals) {
072    this(createFormatterFactory(SsFormat.CUSTOM, precision, decimals));
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * Creates an object of SSPercentField with the specified formatter factory
077   * @param factory - formatter factory to be used
078   */
079  public SsPercentField(AbstractFormatterFactory factory) {
080    super(factory);
081  }
082
083  /**
084   * Get the multiplier used in percent.
085   * @return multiplier
086   */
087  public int getMultiplier() {
088    return getNumberFormatParam((nf) -> nf.getMultiplier());
089  }
090
091  /**
092   * Sets the multiplier for use in percent. With multiplier 100,
093   * 1.23 is formatted as "123", and "123" is parsed into 1.23.
094   * @param multiplier the new multiplier
095   */
096  public void setMultiplier(int multiplier) {
097    setFormatParam((nf) -> nf.setMultiplier(multiplier));
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * Create a FormatterFactory.
102   * @param ssFormat
103   * @param precision - number of digits needed for integer part of the number
104   * @param decimals - number of digits needed for fraction part of the number
105   * @return FormatterFactory.
106   */
107  public static DefaultFormatterFactory createFormatterFactory(
108      SsFormat ssFormat, Integer precision, Integer decimals
109      //, Locale editLocale, Locale displayLocale
110  ) {
111    Objects.requireNonNull(ssFormat);
112
113    NumberFormat displayFormat
114        = createNumberFormat(() -> NumberFormat.getPercentInstance(Locale.US));
115    NumberFormat editFormat = createNumberFormat(() -> NumberFormat.getInstance(Locale.US));
116    // Make sure edit format has the multiplier default for percent.
117    ((DecimalFormat) editFormat).setMultiplier(((DecimalFormat) displayFormat).getMultiplier());
118
119    initPrecision(precision, editFormat, displayFormat);
120    initDecimals(decimals, editFormat, displayFormat);
121
122    return new SsFormatterFactory.Builder<>()
123        .ssFormat(ssFormat)
124        .editFormatter(new SsNumberFormatter(editFormat))
125        .displayFormatter(new SsNumberFormatter(displayFormat))
126        .build();
127  }
128}
